alt: Exhibit TM-10: Moto G Power 2025 Carrier Network Unlock Notification
summary: Android system notification confirmation dialog on the Moto G Power 2025 verifying that the T-Mobile carrier network lock has been successfully removed, displaying the message: 'Your device is already unlocked!'. Proves the EIP reversal and administrative resolution translated directly to physical hardware unlocking.
full_text: Device Unlock Notification: Your device is already unlocked! You can use other carriers' SIM cards in this device. Moto G Power 2025 Carrier SIM network lock successfully lifted following executive intervention.
